lines.1: 「And you just obediently came back to tell us?」
lines.3: The Princess took off running before anyone else.
lines.5: 「Looks like we're gonna see a bloodbath!」
lines.6: 「Sounds like there weren't any men there. Feels like this is turning into a fight between women, so I'm not thrilled about stepping in.」
lines.7: 「They asked for the entire executive committee.」
lines.9: We all headed for Matsukasa Park.
lines.10: Good thing first period was self-study.
lines.11: Inori hadn't even arrived at school yet.
lines.12: Or rather, there she was, just about to enter the grounds.
lines.19: 「...Wait, why is that woman still completely fine?」
lines.20: 「She's tough. If it comes down to it, I'll stop her.」
lines.24: 「That dangerous-looking delinquent next to Yoppi is kind of scary.」
lines.25: 「Still, this place is packed with gorgeous women. And those chests... It's a big-boob paradise.」
lines.27: 「What a feast for the eyes. A whole avenue of eye candy.」
lines.30: 「Something about that girl really annoys me.」
lines.31: 「So what do you people want? I'm not using polite language with anyone who abducted my friend.」
lines.32: 「According to my investigation these past few days...」
lines.33: 「Sato seems to be getting bullied pretty badly.」
lines.34: 「So, at someone's request, I'm going to teach you all a lesson so you stop bullying her.」
lines.38: 「If we were bullying her, we wouldn't all have come running to help her.」
lines.39: 「Maybe, but you also had her doing errands. Could just mean losing your labor would be inconvenient, nya.」
lines.40: 「The bonds of our executive committee are not so petty.」
lines.41: 「Princess, leave this to me. I'll finish it in one minute.」
lines.43: 「Let's test them. One of the girls standing there is actually a fake. We have a master of disguise with us.」
lines.47: 「If you can't tell, the fake is about to reveal herself...」
lines.48: 「Is that really okay? Are Ryuumeikan's bonds only that strong? Are they just a facade?」
lines.49: 「That uniform is from a school in Shonan.」
lines.50: 「These people just keep piling mystery on mystery. Who are they?」
lines.51: 「But is there really a fake among us?」
lines.53: 「I think everyone's real. No disguise could be that perfect.」
lines.55: 「It'll be embarrassing if there really is a fake.」
lines.56: ...Could this be my chance to impress the Princess?
lines.57: 「Leave it to me. I'll expose the impostor.」
lines.58: 「From what they said, we can rule out the men and Otome... And Crab's been with us the whole time, so she shouldn't be the fake either.」
lines.59: 「That leaves the Princess, who ran ahead and disappeared from sight, Inori, who we met on the way, and Nagomi, who arrived later.」
lines.60: Inori was carrying attendance records and everything, so she looked incredibly suspicious.
lines.61: But with her, it was entirely believable she'd just taken them home by accident.
lines.62: 「All right. I'm going to ask the three of you a question. Answer me.」
lines.63: 「Princess, you're secretly in love with me, right?」
lines.64: 「Don't get full of yourself, idiot. Of course I'm not.」
lines.65: 「Nagomi, someday will you eat a meal I cook with all my heart?」
lines.66: 「I have no desire to eat something that disgusting.」
lines.67: 「Inori, please give me extra English lessons later.」
lines.70: 「I know now. The fake is... you!」
